readings.Aries: What you call impatience is actually high sensitivity to wasted potential. Channel it. The energy available today is better used gently.
readings.Taurus: Your senses are your instruments. When did you last use them on something purely for enjoyment? The energy available today is better used gently.
readings.Gemini: The version of events in your head is more interesting than what actually happened. Check the facts. Simpler is correct here.
readings.Cancer: You are allowed to need things. You are not required to justify the need first. One conversation today matters more than the rest combined.
readings.Leo: Something you've been holding as a personal failure is a shared one. Stop carrying it alone. Something you've been measuring incorrectly just corrected itself.
readings.Virgo: The list is long and well-organised. Some things on it no longer belong there. Edit it. Simpler is correct here.
readings.Libra: You are more decisive than you believe. The hesitation is a habit, not a limitation. Go back to the original intention — it's still the right one.
readings.Scorpio: You are in a period of accumulating rather than expending. What you're gathering will matter. The window for this is shorter than it looks.
readings.Sagittarius: Something you said to yourself about your limitations is not accurate. Recalibrate. Simpler is correct here.
readings.Capricorn: The structure you've built is load-bearing in ways you haven't fully mapped. Don't remove anything without knowing what it supports. The window for this is shorter than it looks.
readings.Aquarius: The future belongs to what you're becoming. The present belongs to who you already are. Don't lose track. This situation responds well to direct engagement.
readings.Pisces: Your compassion has no limit and it is currently being used against you by someone who knows this. The timing is better than it feels.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
